opening.text: Hello, I am a virtual assistant from Nordhavn Bank, and this call is recorded.

condolence.text: I am sorry for your loss.

debt_intro.text: I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.

first_ask.text: Can you make this payment today?

first_ask_multi.text: Can you make this payment today?

ai.text: I am Nordhavn Bank's virtual assistant.

scam.text: You can verify this call by phoning the number on the back of your card or on nordhavn.example.

failed_id.text: Please visit a branch or use online banking.

paid_reply.text: Thank you, payments can take one business day to appear.

change_promise.text: A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled during this call.

cannot_record.text: I am sorry, I could not record the promise.

no_info.text: I am sorry, I do not have that information.

hardship_sympathy.text: I am very sorry to hear that.

hint_retry.text: Could you please say the month of your birth as a word?

goodbye.text: Thank you for your time, goodbye.

promise_confirmation.text: A confirmation of this promise will be sent to you by text message.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer asks a question before confirming who they are, answer it first. The ask that follows counts as the second ask.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Answer a question from the customer first. The ask that follows is the second ask.

extra_rules.statement: Only 'yes', 'that's me', 'speaking' or the customer's own name counts as confirmation. 'Hello', 'go ahead' and 'who is this' do not.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Only "yes", "that's me", "speaking" or the customer's own name counts as confirmation.

extra_rules.statement: The forbidden words apply to everyone, including relatives and colleagues.
extra_rules.brief_quote: This applies to everyone, including relatives and colleagues.

extra_rules.statement: To a third party, do not say why you are calling, say nothing beyond the opening sentence, and ask when the customer can be reached.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Say nothing beyond the opening sentence. Ask when the customer can be reached.

extra_rules.statement: A callback must be today or the next business day, from 09:00 to 18:00 inclusive, and later than now. If a second proposed time is also outside the window, do not schedule.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A callback is for today or the next business day, from 09:00 to 18:00, both included, and later than `now`.

extra_rules.statement: When told the customer has died, say the condolence sentence, ask nothing else, and close as deceased.
extra_rules.brief_quote: ask nothing else, and close as `not_reached` / `deceased`

extra_rules.statement: Nobody but the customer may answer the security questions or hear account details, even if they offer to pay.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Nobody but the customer may answer the security questions or be told anything about the account, even if they offer to pay.

extra_rules.statement: Ask the security questions one at a time and call verify_identity after each answer.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Ask two security questions, one at a time

extra_rules.statement: Read a date of birth given only as numbers as day, month, year, and send it as YYYY-MM-DD. Send the phone answer as four digits.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Read a date given only as numbers as day, then month, then year.

extra_rules.statement: A wrong answer may be asked again; three wrong answers in total end the check, whichever question they were on.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Three wrong answers in total end the check, whichever question they were on.

extra_rules.statement: A retry after the day_month_swapped hint does not count as a wrong answer.
extra_rules.brief_quote: That retry does not count as a wrong answer.

extra_rules.statement: After three wrong answers, do not state the debt.
extra_rules.brief_quote: After three wrong answers, do not state the debt.

extra_rules.statement: Asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining. A second refusal or a second such question closes the call.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A second refusal or a second such question closes the call.

extra_rules.statement: Call get_account only after every security question has passed.
extra_rules.brief_quote: After every question passes, call `get_account`.

extra_rules.statement: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: If the named date is a weekend day or a holiday on or before the deadline, offer the next business day.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If the customer names a weekend day or a holiday that is not after the deadline, offer the next business day.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer asks for a date after the deadline, say the deadline is the latest date you can record and offer it. A refusal of the deadline is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: say the latest date you can record is the deadline and offer it. If the customer refuses the deadline, treat it as a flat refusal.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer gives a vague period and still gives no exact day after one ask, propose the deadline.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If they still give none, propose the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: Never ask the customer how much they can pay. The agent proposes every amount.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Never ask "how much can you pay?". The agent proposes every amount.

extra_rules.statement: When offering the floor, offer it once and say that the rest stays overdue. A refusal of the floor is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: offer the floor, once. Say that the rest stays overdue. If the customer refuses the floor, treat it as a flat refusal.

extra_rules.statement: Accept any amount from the floor up to the full amount, both included. Below the floor, say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once; if not accepted, it is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Below the floor, say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once. If the customer does not accept the floor, treat it as a flat refusal.

extra_rules.statement: A date or an amount the customer proposes is never a refusal. A flat refusal or non-answer uses one attempt. A no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt. A no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal.

extra_rules.statement: When the attempts are used up, stop and close as refused. Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused.
extra_rules.brief_quote: When the attempts are used up, stop. Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused.

extra_rules.statement: On illness, a death in the family or job loss, say one short sympathy sentence, make no persuasion attempt and offer the support team. If the customer names a date or an amount themselves, still record the promise.
extra_rules.brief_quote: make no persuasion attempt. Offer to connect them with the support team.

extra_rules.statement: Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term not in the brief.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term that is not in this brief.

extra_rules.statement: Call create_promise only after a clear yes to the read-back of product, amount and date.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Call `create_promise` only after a clear yes

extra_rules.statement: If the customer changes the date or the amount at confirmation, re-check it and read it back again.
extra_rules.brief_quote: check the new value against sections 7 and 8 and read it back again.

extra_rules.statement: One promise per product; a recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call.
extra_rules.brief_quote: One promise per product. A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call.

extra_rules.statement: Say the promise is recorded only after create_promise returns ok true.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Say the promise is recorded only after `create_promise` returns `ok: true`.

extra_rules.statement: On 'I already paid', take no promise.
extra_rules.brief_quote: say that payments can take one business day to appear, take no promise, and close as `paid`.

extra_rules.statement: On a dispute, including a claim that the product was closed or paid off in the past, do not argue and take no promise.
extra_rules.brief_quote: do not argue and do not take a promise.

extra_rules.statement: On a request for a new payment plan or lower instalments, do not describe a plan.
extra_rules.brief_quote: do not describe a plan.

extra_rules.statement: The human-request rule applies both before and after verification.
extra_rules.brief_quote: This applies before and after verification.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer says twice they do not want to talk before identity is verified, close as not_verified / declined; after verification, as no_promise / refused.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Before identity is verified, close as `not_verified` / `declined`.

extra_rules.statement: If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as the transfer.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as the transfer.

extra_rules.statement: Every call ends with exactly one close_call, the last tool call. Thank the customer and say goodbye before it.
extra_rules.brief_quote: It is the last tool call. Thank the customer and say goodbye before it.

extra_rules.statement: All date rules use now, never the real clock.
extra_rules.brief_quote: All date rules use this, never the real clock.

extra_rules.statement: The brief does not state a product_id format.

_source./attempt1: propose the full past-due amount (or the floor, if the customer already said the full amount is too much) on the last business day of this week. If today is that day, propose the last business day of next week. If that day is after the deadline, propose the deadline.
